_meta.why: THE source of product truth (TRUTH LAW). Maya may state a price, a stock level, a delivery time or a spec ONLY if it appears here. A field left empty is a fact she does not have — she says she'll check. Phase 3 syncs this file from the client's Google Sheet via n8n; the shape does not change.
_meta.forbidden_claims: Per product, the regulated words this client must never have said on their stream (cosmetics/supplement law). The backend alerts the operator if one appears in an outbound line. It is an alarm, not a filter — the real block is the brain's pre-synthesis truth gate.
_meta.commerce: L6: payment_link = the per-product checkout URL (Stripe/Grow/Meshulam) — null means the post_link tool alerts the operator instead of posting. coupon = the PER-STREAM attribution code, set before each stream; it is how revenue gets attributed to Maya (no coupon = no proof = no retainer renewal). in_stock=false auto-removes the product from the rundown and from the brain answers.
